headline: Advait Energy Transitions reports 88.5 percent Q2 FY27 profit growth

headline: Advait Energy Transitions approves subsidiary share acquisition and employee stock options

summary: Advait Energy Transitions held a board meeting on October 30, 2026, to finalize corporate actions. The company approved the grant of Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) units to its staff. These moves are intended to incentivize employees and consolidate ownership within the group's subsidiary structure.
why_it_matters: Internal restructuring and employee incentives signal long-term operational focus.
